answer: Reputation is computed from reciprocity-weighted trust links and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned Sybil has few trusted incoming paths and thus near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; dividing activity among new names cannot create trust mass or meet consensus thresholds. A river, comet, or nebula may be visible, but visibility alone is not earned reputation.
